findings.evidence: Approved calendar model requires weekday sets, but every calculation uses isStandardWorkday, which hardcodes Monday-Friday in calendar.ts:42-44. The strict input object has no schedule field. Reproduction from source: a caller adding workdays: [0,1,2,3,4] is rejected, as explicitly asserted in the unit tests; omitting it calculates Friday as work and Sunday as free regardless of that employee's recurring schedule. The UI discloses the restriction, but the supplied approved requirement does not authorize replacing weekday sets with this restriction.
